title: THE UNMADE — Definitive Canon Encyclopedia
status: Source-derived editorial reference. Does not certify Unreal gameplay, assets or release readiness.
guardrails: No fabricated items, abilities, characters, bosses or outcomes
Two final mornings remain alternate choices
Optional Echo, guardian and observatory quests never gate the main story
Personal testimony and rumor remain distinct

entries.name: The Bell Fell and Stood
entries.summary: A monster and its innocent keeper may stand in contradictory versions of the same place; mercy and truth need not annihilate one another.

entries.name: The Place Before a First Story
entries.summary: Beyond the coast is a border with neither maps nor ownership. Ten learned disciplines offer choices but no automatic victory over existence itself.
